notes.title: Going into Beta next week
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26901344/286adeecaac43a61cee514e86216b81da78e348c.jpg[/img]

Beta will be on the way in the next week or two.

This update will focus on the multiplayer component of the game.

[*]The open play map has a few new Points of Interest. 
[*]We also are including a marker to clearly show the mining zones more clearly for low render distances.
[*]More insects will be added like the Wasp and the Fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26901344/c9fb1daa2c422f1acfd1c3c640b3f761d5d2599c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Going into beta :)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/836e836931acea79b023439445e61bf05f3ea49d.png[/img]

[h1]This is our [b][u]biggest[/u][/b] update to date includes .....[/h1]
Multiplayer open play. Players can do what ever they want in this game mode. Players can also mine skins from the "Loot Crystals"
These can be traded or sold on the steam market.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]

- Multiplayer overhaul 
- Steam inventory drops +-75 skins to collect and trade.
- 4km of open play game play 
- New critters to contend with

[b]Single player [/b]
-2 new levels 

[b]Nvidia Ansel support [/b]

Loads of fixes and balances to all classes. 
Not to worry the old multiplayer will be back soon.
We just need sometime to polish it up and put it back in.

Enjoy !
-CarVin Team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/69bcb245bce5c9f31a76095ff90581bd57a5f875.png[/img]

notes.title: Post Beta Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/3c75d9adbcd475c347912b1daa754c09f10f2570.png[/img]
We are preparing to release into beta, which will be the culmination of a years worth of work put into the game. This update has taken so long to arrive because the core of multiplayer has been changed quite a lot and needed to be fixed properly before updating. 

We have also started working on Steam Inventory service for Spider Wars. This means initially Spider Skins will be coming into the game obtainable in-game. You will be seeing the first batch of common loot type skins that will be expected.


This will be the last chance to get Spider Wars at it's reduced price of $5. Once we go into Beta we will be increasing it's price accordingly to the content that has been put into the game.

We would also like to take this time to thank our Patreons for supporting us, you have directly helped bring out this update and we really appreciate it. If you would like to support us on Patreon you can do so on the following link.
https://www.patreon.com/SpiderWars

We hope you had a great weekend,
- CarVin Team

notes.title: Internal Beta Test and Glider movement rework
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/7d5abd39bf5231fbc52e794dddd2d1bf73decaa9.jpg[/img]

Good day!
We recently ran an internal beta test on the multiplayer.The purpose of the beta stress the load onto the server with the new open world multiplayer map. This test ran smoothly with 6 players, highlighted some minor issues and gathered some good feedback from those involved. 

We plan to have more, larger scale test soon where we will involve the community on specific days, more information regarding this will be posted in the Spiders Wars steam group.

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/spiderwars

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/17057ff47c614d9e3db5b3a1796bfc80a564662d.jpg[/img]

The Glider class has also received a update to its movement system as we thought it was too powerful compared to the other classes. This was also done to bring the gliders movement mechanics more in line with its name as previously it was more of a flyer than a glider. The Glider is still remains one of the most effective classes when it comes to mobility. We have also updated the particles to the gliders thrust and boost particles along with some other spider abilities.

We hope to see you in the upcoming beta test and appreciate any feedback you have for us.

Have a great weekend,
- CarVin Team

notes.content:

notes.title: New feature in survival
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/7fb94d7e081aaf4b431748730711038f8b9e5bf7.png[/img]
The survival based map and mode will come with it's own unique features. One such feature will involve resource extractions from fallen crystals. 

These extractions will occur when the player interacts with a rare crystal that will fall down from the sky. There will then be a refinery unit that is dropped from space. The refinery unit will harvest the designated crystal over a period of time in which the player will have to defend the refinery unit from other players. There will be a shield split evenly among the player, their friends and the refinery unit up to a limited range. This shield will serve the purpose of helping the player defend the refinery units until departure.

Players attacking the refinery unit and its' defenders will have to capture possession of it before the unit leaves after a set time.

We hope you have a great weekend,
- CarVin Team

notes.title: Update on the Flora and Fauna
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/308aab88c1c6c8ac2e3e3b272f9bd2bdf0373bf3.png[/img]
The flora system is meant to introduce a more natural feeling to the levels. This includes flora that seeds and dies, transforming the different biomes every time you play the game. 

Fauna will be introduced to help manage the biomes and give the players more competition. The fauna system is not fully introduced yet, so we will be working hard on finishing this.

We hope you have a great weekend.
- CarVin Team

notes.title: Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, 

I am a new addition to the CarVin Team and I am hoping to bring in some fresh views, abilities and development done to the Spider Wars Universe!

We also have some updates coming to Spider Wars soon.

These changes involve:
- Menu UI has been reworked to keep the style and theme coherent.
- Chameleon Neutral Enemy added (Will Target AI bugs).
- Crab Hostile Enemy added to patrol the coastal line (Will Target players).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/caa395b5a4b9989e19cb2da8c60f83ed7fe944de.png[/img]

These changes may be small and mainly affect, but they should appear more often and hopefully get bigger and better as time goes on.

Feel free to post any suggestions or  leave feedback, I am here and i am amped!

Happy Lunar New Years!
CarVin Team

notes.title: Single Player update #2 info
notes.content:
The second single player update will be done within the next month.
We are working hard to bring you more than just build a web mode.
There is a story in the works and this is just the first chapter in many more to come. For the time being we are not going to be focusing on multiplayer at all and devote all our funding and attention towards a single player story. We are also making sure not to miss out the importance of co-op, which will be our second priority. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/2e313596628481bea9a34b71d0b08bde264cd859.jpg[/img]

Here are two images as a sneak peak of a new level to be included in the next update. We really appreciate the feedback from you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/4076e0eb3755867dee11e11bf55bdf87acc07734.jpg[/img]


Thank you to everyone so far for all your support!
